artworks.title: On n'est jamais bien servi que par soi-même
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of an anthropomorphic creature polishing boots. A figure with a human-like body and an animal head, resembling a donkey, is cleaning a pair of boots. The character is dressed casually with a bandana around its head, focusing on the task. One boot is on the ground, and the other is being polished on a table with polish and a brush nearby. The detailed drawing style includes fine lines for texture and shading, creating depth. The setting suggests an indoor domestic environment. The caption below the drawing states, "On n'est jamais bien servi que par soi-même," translating to, "One is never served well except by oneself."

artworks.title: Seated Nude
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on blue-gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: The image shows a full body drawing of a person seated on a draped chair or platform. The person is reclining with one leg bent at the knee and the foot resting on the seat, while the other leg is extended downward. The figure's head is slightly tilted downward and to the side, without distinct facial features. The person's hair is smooth and short, styled close to the head. The figure is not wearing any clothing, but draped fabric is present around the seat and partially covers one leg. The background is plain and unadorned, with a neutral tone that does not depict any specific setting or environment.

artworks.title: Le mari lisant: nous étions mollement étendus...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a bedroom, focusing on the bed where both are located. One person is reclining in bed with a book or paper, smiling, wearing a nightcap and nightgown. The other person sits on the edge of the bed, leaning towards the first person. They have light-colored hair under a striped nightcap, wearing a robe or nightgown. A candle on a side table provides light, with drawn curtains framing the scene. The floor by the bed displays shoes or slippers and scattered items, while the background shows textured shading, resembling a night-time interior.

artworks.title: Il n'ya pas pourtant qu'une heure que je tire!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing on a balcony or railing structure. He is leaning forward, holding a broken parasol and has exaggerated facial features. He wears a top hat, tailcoat, and pants, all dark in color and appears disheveled. In the background, a woman's face is partially visible through a door or wall opening. Sketchy lines fill the abstract background behind the railing. The image has text overlay at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Le dernier bain!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The illustration shows a person leaning over the edge of a platform, biting onto a rope. Their face is visible with defined features, short wind-swept hair, and dressed in a dark garment. Their feet are tied to the platform with cloth. A large stone block is connected to the rope they grip. In the background, a figure is fishing near the water's edge. There are faint architectural structures or rocks in the background. The scene is surrounded by a light, blank background.

artworks.title: Allons lancez vous père goutot...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature of a person sitting on a wooden structure, presumably a ladder or stairs, entering a wooden bathing area. The person's body is mostly shown, seated with knees bent, and supported by one hand on the ladder. The face has exaggerated features like bulging eyes and a prominent nose, with a receding hairline and a few tufts of hair. The man is wearing shorts or a bathing suit bottom. In front of him, there is water, in which another head with similar exaggerated features is floating. Above the seated figure, the legs of another person walking are visible, but the rest of the body is cut off from view. The background consists of wooden planks as the walls of the bathing area.

artworks.title: Pauvre jeune homme!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man kneeling on the ground, facing a tree and carving into its trunk. He has a pointed nose, a receding hairline, long hair, a mustache, and a small beard. He wears a dark long coat and light pants. His hands hold a carving tool. The background shows an outdoor scene with abstract lines representing foliage and clouds, with some grass and vegetation around the tree.

artworks.title: Grand Gueux va! je voudrais t'y voir
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic scene in a public establishment. The drawing shows four figures. One figure, a woman, is leaning towards a standing man who is holding a glass. The man is wearing dark trousers and a light-colored shirt, and he is holding a stick or cane. In the background, there are two other figures engaged in the setting. There is a table with bottles and another small table in the foreground. The style of the drawing is characterized by expressive line work and a focus on social interaction. The background suggests an indoor, tavern-like environment.

artworks.title: L'or est une chimère
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his body slightly turned to his left. He is wearing a top hat and a coat with a scarf tied around his neck. His facial features appear elongated, and his expression is one of displeasure or contemplation as he looks toward a window. His hair is mostly concealed beneath the hat, with a few strands visible. He is wearing a long overcoat that reaches past his hips, and his hands are tucked into his pockets. The man stands on a textured floor, and to his right is a large storefront display window filled with coiled items. The background includes a wall decorated with vertical lines. The image has inscriptions at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Il ne faut pas mettre le doigt ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of caricatured figures in a scene. A tall, gaunt figure on the left holds what appears to be a distorted mask or puppet. This figure is dressed formally. To the right, two figures are shown, with one pulling the other's hair. The setting is depicted as cracked pavement or cobblestones. The words "Proverbes et Maximes" appear at the top, with a French caption at the bottom translating to "You should not put your finger between the wood and the bark."

artworks.title: En voila un de jobard! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking down a street, leaning slightly forward with one hand tucked into his coat as he takes a stride. The man has a wrinkled face with a broad nose and is wearing a top hat. He has short and somewhat unkempt hair peeking out from under the hat. He is dressed in an overcoat, a waistcoat, a shirt, a cravat or scarf, tight-fitting trousers, and pointed shoes. In his right hand, partially hidden within his coat, he clutches some unseen objects. Behind him, there is another individual leaning on a cane or stick. The background features a loosely sketched street scene with buildings, and the foreground includes a published text and printed signatures. The image is framed in a decorative border.

artworks.title: Cabriolet là M'sieu,  là M'sieu...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two men from head to toe. The man on the left stands in a slightly angled posture with one hand in his pocket and the other arm relaxed at his side. He has a long, narrow face with a long nose, wears a tall, cylindrical top hat, and is dressed in a formal outfit that includes a suit with a waistcoat and cravat. The man appears to be wearing dark shoes. The ground shows a cobblestone street leading to a horse-drawn carriage on the right. The man on the right seems to be conversing with the first man while holding the horse's reins. He wears a similarly styled hat, a simple coat, a scarf, loose fitting pants, and sturdy shoes. His expression appears animated, with wide eyes, pronounced eyebrows, and lips. The background includes building facades with vertical lines indicating rain, and the back of the carriage is blurry on the right side of the drawing.

artworks.title: ce qui prouve que quand on fait...patrouille...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in military attire in an urban setting. The drawing shows four soldiers huddled closely together as they move through what appears to be a dark alleyway or street. The soldiers are wearing uniforms with plumed helmets and each appears to be carrying a rifle with a bayonet. In the background is the façade of a building with a window, illuminated by an interior light, which casts a silhouette of a person or mannequin looking outwards. The scene is rendered in monochrome, capturing the nocturnal atmosphere with intense vertical shading and shadows. The text above and below the image, in French, adds a narrative element to the scene, titled "ÉMOTIONS PARISIENNES".

artworks.title: M'ame Bonneau... J'aime m'ame Bonneau moi!...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures from the waist up. On the left, a person leans forward with a hunched posture, wearing a robe and a nightcap. Their facial features include a pointed nose and a prominent chin, captured in a side profile. The person on the right stands upright with their head tilted back, facing the left figure. They have a round face with a long nose and a surprised expression. Their hair is partially covered by a bonnet, and they wear a pleated garment. Both figures appear engaged in conversation with animated expressions. No visible jewelry or objects are present. The background is a rough, textured area emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Pardon...je suis courtier de commerce...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals: one standing and one lying in bed. The standing man is depicted in a full-body profile view, holding a top hat by his side. His facial features are exaggerated, with a prominent nose and receding hairline visible. He is dressed in a long coat with trousers and shoes. The man in bed is only partially visible, with his upper body covered by blankets. His head is supported by pillows, and he wears a nightcap. The surroundings include a bedside table next to the bed with several bottles and cups placed on it. The background features curtains partially open, creating a shaded area behind the bed, and a framed picture hanging on the wall.

artworks.title: Désagrément de causer avec les gens...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in a tense interaction. One figure has wide eyes, a furrowed brow, an open mouth, and animated hand gestures. The other figure has an intense gaze and is gripping the first figure by the lapels. Their bodies are close, indicating a confrontation or urgency. The drawing style is reminiscent of Honoré Daumier, known for societal critiques through caricatures. Bold lines and shading add depth and intensity to the scene, capturing the emotional charge of the moment.

artworks.title: Traquenards politiques
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with various figures interacting with labeled arches. The artwork includes a naked figure, a donkey, and two clothed figures. One of the figures is inspecting the contents under a banner labeled 'Finances.' Another figure is near a donkey under an arch labeled 'Culte,' with a third figure seated next to them. The drawing utilizes various textures and shading techniques to create depth and perspective, resembling a satirical style. The expressions and postures of the figures emphasize humor and critique in the piece, typical of historical satire.

artworks.title: Robert Macaire commis-voyageur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features two men in a dynamic interaction. The man on the left is positioned defensively, with one hand on his hip and the other raised near his ear. He has a scrunched-up facial expression and wears a cap, a jacket, a vest, and pinstriped pants. The man on the right is gesturing towards the other man with an outstretched hand. He appears engaged in conversation, leaning forward with a slightly open mouth and wide eyes. He has short curly hair and wears a long coat, a neck scarf, and matching trousers. Both men have exaggerated features typical of caricatures. The background consists of vertical lines and shading. The image contains text and artistic elements at the bottom.

artworks.title: La Vue
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three people are standing close together, looking up towards the sky. The tallest person in the middle leans back slightly. The man has exaggerated features, long pointed nose, and a chin that juts forward. He wears a tall top hat, a dark coat, and a light-colored shirt. A woman with large round eyes and a similar nose stands behind him. On the other side, a child wearing a wide-brimmed hat looks up. In the background, there are tall buildings, another structure, and a crescent moon. The image is sketched in a monochromatic style.

artworks.title: La Dot...vous connaissez la fortune...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing from the knees up. The man on the left has his hands around a top hat, while the man on the right extends his arms forward. The man on the left looks reserved, with a long face, pronounced chin, and thin, slightly disheveled hair. He wears a formal outfit with a long coat, waistcoat, and bow tie. The man on the right appears more animated, with a round face, curly hair, and an open mouth. He is dressed similarly, with a dark bow tie, light waistcoat, and dark coat with tails. The background is simple with faint horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Une promenade d'argrément aux Champs-Elysées
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a crowded street at the Champs-Élysées with people, trees, and a large beam. Figures maneuver through the lively avenue, with one person avoiding a beam carried by another. Background figures walk or stand in the scene. The drawing is detailed with bold lines, capturing motion and expressions in a caricature style from the 19th century.

artworks.title: Le barbier pense a ses créanciers...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image shows two individuals in a barbershop setting. One person is seated holding a basin, with a cloth draped around their neck. They have exaggerated facial features and dark, slicked back hair. The other individual, standing in front, is wearing a long apron and has prominent facial features and thick, curly hair. They are holding a straight razor. In the background, there is a table with glasses and a ball-like object. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic, sketch-like style.

artworks.title: Dis donc, Macaire, qué que c'est que c'thé...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures and a large vase. An elderly man is kneeling and mixing something in the vase while an older figure on the right observes. The figure in the center is holding a lid and an object, while the man on the far left is also kneeling. The indoor setting has minimal furnishings, a hat on the wall, and the figures are dressed in tattered clothing. The style includes exaggerated expressions and postures.

artworks.title: Dis donc, not'homme, faut-y ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals gathered in an art gallery or salon setting. The central figure is an older man wearing a top hat and a decorated waistcoat, standing close to a woman. The woman beside him is wearing a headscarf and a striped dress. Another man, wearing glasses and a bowler hat, stands behind them. The background shows blurred figures resembling audience members observing art pieces, with a sculpture of a nude figure partially visible on the right-hand side.
